blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Prime Minister is covered under the jurisdiction, accompanied by specific safeguards.
Union Ministers and all Members of Parliament (MPs) fall directly under this jurisdiction.
Coverage extends comprehensively to all categories of central government employees.
Societies and NGOs receiving government funding above a designated limit are included.
Note that the Prime Minister is NOT completely exempt from jurisdiction; coverage applies with specific safeguards.
Jurisdiction is not limited to senior officers; it includes ALL categories of central government employees.
Non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and societies fall under this jurisdiction if they receive government funds above a specified limit.

blocks.content: • All categories of central government employees
• Societies/NGOs receiving government funds above a specified limit
